description: KULIC Advisory Execution Toolkit Library. Returns one template by its id (T01 to T44) from list_templates: what it is for and for whom, the download link and, for Excel templates, the structure read from the file: sheets, sections, the columns of each table, which columns the file calculates itself, the dropdown values and the first cell of each table. For the three Word templates (master service agreement, NDA, SLA) it returns the full text with the placeholders in square brackets. PDF entries come with description and link only. The files are in English and are working templates, not legal or tax advice. Fill a table or a Word template with fill_template. No AI, no sign-in, nothing stored.

id.description: Id of the template, T01 to T44, from list_templates.

language.description: Language of the description. Default de. Structure and text stay in English as in the file.

name: get_template
title: Read one template of the Execution Toolkit Library: what it is for, its structure and the download link
